description: This Java class acts as a command handler for creating provisioning criteria requests within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses a service to process provisioning criteria creation based on received JSON commands.

classes.name: CreateProvisioningCriteriaRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles command processing for creating provisioning criteria, delegating the creation logic to ProvisioningCriteriaWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CreateProvisioningCriteriaRequestCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the provisioning criteria write service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create provisioning criteria and returns the result.
